covered: Only the selected predecessor gets a durable retirement descriptor before intent or selector publication.
Initial legacy selection, repeated same selection and unrelated staged generations are not marked.
Retries preserve the exact descriptor and resume after interruption between retirement and intent.
Retirement publication failure prevents intent/selector changes.
Symlink metadata is rejected before transition.
Existing live restore, HA and crash/retry intent boundaries remain passing.
limits: No application generation reaper is implemented in this change.
Retirement does not imply deletion eligibility; current selector, intent, live store roots and active filesystem readers remain protected.
The ongoing native full compaction attempt uses the earlier frozen acknowledgement-fix binary and does not validate this retirement change.
